sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的一档全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: On Sunday, January 10, 1993, 54-year-old pig farmer Ralph Volmer and his 49-year-old wife
sentences.zh: 1993年1月10日星期日，54岁的养猪农场主拉尔夫·沃尔默（Ralph Volmer）和49岁的妻子

sentences.en: Joan returned home from a week-long interstate trip.
sentences.zh: 琼（Joan）结束了一周的州际旅行回到家中。

sentences.en: The couple, who lived in the Victorian country town of Antwerp, had driven four and a half
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇住在维多利亚州的乡村小镇安特卫普（Antwerp），他们开车向西行驶了四个半

sentences.en: hours west to attend a six-day religious convention in the South Australian capital of Adelaide.
sentences.zh: 小时，前往南澳大利亚州首府阿德莱德参加为期六天的宗教大会。

sentences.en: Ralph, a devout and ardent Christian, had been eager to attend the event.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫是一个虔诚狂热的基督徒，他一直渴望参加这次活动。

sentences.en: And while Joan didn't share her husband's fervour, she attended church regularly, and so agreed to accompany him.
sentences.zh: 虽然琼并不像丈夫那样狂热，但她定期去教堂，所以同意陪他一同前往。

sentences.en: The vacation had passed without incident, but shortly after their arrival home, Joan started to behave oddly.
sentences.zh: 假期过得很平静，但回到家不久后，琼的行为就开始变得古怪起来。

sentences.en: She had difficulty concentrating on tasks, would frequently change outfits throughout the day, was restless, and struggled to fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 她很难集中精力做事，一天中会频繁更换衣服，坐立不安，并且难以入睡。

sentences.en: According to Ralph, as time went on, she also started making peculiar noises and adopting different personas.
sentences.zh: 据拉尔夫回忆，随着时间的推移，她还开始发出奇怪的声音并扮演不同的性格。

sentences.en: On one occasion, she acted as though she were a sheep shearer, speaking in a tone and manner consistent with a farmhand.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她表现得像个剪羊毛工，说话的语气和举止都符合一个农场短工的特征。

sentences.en: On another, she claimed to be a sex worker, while describing the activities she had participated in with supposed clients.
sentences.zh: 另一次，她自称是一名性工作者，并描述了她与所谓客户进行的那些活动。

sentences.en: It wasn't the first time Ralph had witnessed a Joan behaving this way.
sentences.zh: 这并不是拉尔夫第一次看到琼表现出这般模样。

sentences.en: Two years earlier, she was hospitalised briefly for mental illness, but had made a fairly quick recovery and had been in good health ever since.
sentences.zh: 两年前，她曾因精神疾病短暂住院，但恢复得相当快，此后一直很健康。

sentences.en: Now, it appeared her symptoms were returning.
sentences.zh: 现在，她的症状似乎又复发了。

sentences.en: Over the course of the next two weeks, they seemed to worsen, particularly at night time.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两周里，这些症状似乎越来越严重，尤其是在夜间。

sentences.en: On the evening of Friday January 22, Ralph returned home to find Joan waving her arms and dancing in their property's paddocks.
sentences.zh: 1月22日星期五晚上，拉尔夫回到家，发现琼在他们庄园的牧场里挥舞着手臂跳舞。

sentences.en: Deeply troubled by the way his wife's wellbeing had deteriorated, Ralph prayed to God for guidance.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫对妻子健康状况的恶化深感不安，于是向上帝祈求指引。

sentences.en: The Wimmera is a regional inland district in Victoria's west, predominantly characterised
sentences.zh: 威姆拉（Wimmera）是维多利亚州西部的一个内陆地区，其特点主要为

sentences.en: north by dry, flat farmlands and a 278 kilometre intermittent river that bears the same name.
sentences.zh: 北部是干燥平坦的农田，以及一条长达278公里、时断时续的同名河流。

sentences.en: Passing through the region's unofficial capital city of Horsham, the river winds west and then
sentences.zh: 河流穿过该地区非官方的首府城市霍舍姆（Horsham），向西蜿蜒然后

sentences.en: continues north to Antwerp, a tiny outback town named after the Belgian home city of an early
sentences.zh: 继续向北流向安特卫普，这是一个以早期欧洲定居者的比利时故乡命名的偏远小镇。

sentences.en: European settler.
sentences.zh: 欧洲定居者。

sentences.en: In the 1860s, two Protestant missionaries arrived in Antwerp and to build a church and mission where they aimed to convert the local Indigenous population.
sentences.zh: 19世纪60年代，两名新教传教士抵达安特卫普，建立了一座教堂和传教站，旨在将当地的原住民人口皈依基督教。

sentences.en: The mission was closed 40 years later due to low congregation numbers and today stands as a tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 40年后，由于会众人数稀少，该传教站关闭，如今已成为一个旅游景点。

sentences.en: Towards the end of the 20th century, Antwerp was home to just 63 inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 20世纪末，安特卫普仅居住着63名居民。

sentences.en: It had a licensed general store, a rail siding and a small station where residents could catch a bus to Horsham twice a week.
sentences.zh: 这里有一家有执照的综合杂货店、一个铁路支线和一个小车站，居民可以在那里每周坐两次巴士去霍舍姆。

sentences.en: The two-lane Dimboola Rainbow Road carved through the town's sprawling fields, which were dotted
sentences.zh: 双车道的丁布拉-雷恩博路（Dimboola Rainbow Road）穿过小镇绵延的田野，田野里点缀着

sentences.en: by scrubs and eucalyptus trees, and several disused grain silos stood out against the mostly natural landscape.
sentences.zh: 灌木丛和桉树，几座废弃的粮仓在近乎纯天然的景观中格外显眼。

sentences.en: Ralph and Joan Vollmer had moved to Antwerp in the late 1980s, purchasing one of the town's traditional farmsteads where they raised pigs.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫和琼·沃尔默于20世纪80年代末搬到安特卫普，买下了镇上一处传统的农庄并在那里养猪。

sentences.en: Born in Germany in 1938, right before the outbreak of World War II, Ralph had emigrated to Australia with his family when he was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫1938年出生于德国，正值二战爆发前夕，他在十几岁时随家人移民到了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: He had completed primary school in Germany, but the move interrupted his education and he never enrolled in secondary school.
sentences.zh: 他在德国读完了小学，但这次搬迁中断了他的学业，他再也没有注册上中学。

sentences.en: His family moved to the Melbourne suburb of Caulfield and his parents both worked in factory production.
sentences.zh: 他的家人搬到了墨尔本的考field郊区，父母都在工厂从事生产工作。

sentences.en: Eventually, they saved enough money from working overtime to afford a small rural property in
sentences.zh: 最终，他们通过加班攒够了钱，买下了吉普斯兰（Gippsland）的一处小型农村房产，

sentences.en: Gippsland, a region in the state's southeaSt.
sentences.zh: 吉普斯兰是该州东南部的一个地区。

sentences.en: Ralph grew up to be a softly spoken man who found it difficult to trust others and mostly kept to himself, but when he did form friendships, they were extremely strong.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫长大后成了一个轻声细语的人，觉得很难信任别人，大多独来独往，但一旦建立起友谊，就会非常深厚。

sentences.en: He worked as a farmhand and performed odd jobs before meeting his first wife and settling down in the Gippsland town of Yarram.
sentences.zh: 在遇到第一任妻子并在吉普斯兰的亚勒姆（Yarram）小镇安顿下来之前，他当过农场杂工并做过零工。

sentences.en: The couple had two sons, but the marriage ended in the mid-1970s.
sentences.zh: 两人育有两个儿子，但这段婚姻在20世纪70年代中期结束了。

sentences.en: Following the divorce, Ralph remained single until 1986 when he met and fell in love with Joan.
sentences.zh: 离婚后，拉尔夫一直单身，直到1986年遇到了琼并坠入爱河。

sentences.en: Joan Lenora Taylor was a petite woman with short, wavy, light brown hair, who was typically described as shy, gentle and loving.
sentences.zh: 琼·莱诺拉·泰勒（Joan Lenora Taylor）身材娇小，留着一头短而卷曲的浅棕色头发，通常被描述为害羞、温柔而充满爱心。

sentences.en: Her childhood and early adulthood were marred by sexual abuse and she was later diagnosed with
sentences.zh: 她的童年和成年早期饱受性虐待的折磨，后来被诊断出患有

sentences.en: schizophrenia, resulting in several stints in mental health hospitals, which left her with a fear of psychiatric care.
sentences.zh: 精神分裂症，导致她多次进出精神病院，这使她对精神科护理产生了恐惧。

sentences.en: She struggled to make friends and maintain ongoing work, though she adored children and had been employed as a nanny for a time.
sentences.zh: 她很难结交朋友和维持长期工作，不过她非常喜欢孩子，曾受雇做过保姆。

sentences.en: As a young woman, she married and had a baby, but was left in a state of anxiety and blame when her husband took his own life.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，她结过婚并生了一个孩子，但当丈夫自杀身亡时，她陷入了焦虑和自责的状态。

sentences.en: Her life appeared to turn around in her early 40s when she met Ralph, who later compared their early relationship to a miracle.
sentences.zh: 在她40岁出头遇到拉尔夫时，她的人生似乎迎来了转机，拉尔夫后来将他们早期的恋情比作奇迹。

sentences.en: The new couple decided to start a fresh life together in an entirely different part of the estate, settling on the Wimmera region and purchasing the farm in Antwerp in 1988.
sentences.zh: 这对新夫妇决定在庄园一个完全不同的地方开始崭新的生活，他们选中了威姆拉地区，并于1988年买下了安特卫普的农场。

sentences.en: Their new home was a single-storey weatherboard farmhouse with a wide veranda that sat at the end of a 500-metre dirt driveway framed by several trees.
sentences.zh: 他们的新家是一座单层木板农舍，带有宽阔的游廊，坐落在一处长达500米、两侧点缀着几棵树的泥土车道的尽头。

sentences.en: The rear of the property backed onto the banks of the Wimmera River.
sentences.zh: 房子的背面紧邻威姆拉河岸。

sentences.en: Joan, an avid gardener, immediately set about planting a neat border of garden beds around the house and establishing a green house.
sentences.zh: 琼是一位狂热的园艺爱好者，她立刻着手在房子周围种植了一圈整齐的花坛，并建立了一个温室。

sentences.en: She also decorated her new home with vases, porcelain ornaments and cat figurines.
sentences.zh: 她还用花瓶、瓷制装饰品和猫咪小雕像装点着她的新家。

sentences.en: The couple didn't involve themselves in the local community, but those who met Joan in town described her as friendly.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇没有参与当地社区的活动，但在镇上遇到琼的人都说她很友善。

sentences.en: Neither Ralph nor Joan had been religious when they met, but several years into their relationship, they discovered their faith and became Christians.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫和琼在相遇时都没有宗教信仰，但在恋爱几年后，他们发现了信仰并成为了基督徒。

sentences.en: They married at Horsham's Salvation Army Church in 1989 and began attending Sunday Mass there.
sentences.zh: 1989年，他们在霍舍姆的救世军教堂结婚，并开始在那里参加周日弥撒。

sentences.en: Ralph was a far more impassioned believer compared to his wife, spending his spare time listening to hymns and reading religious texts, while Joan preferred to watch television.
sentences.zh: 与妻子相比，拉尔夫是一个更加热诚的信徒，他把业余时间都用来听圣歌和阅读宗教文本，而琼则更喜欢看电视。

sentences.en: She was content to be involved with the church, but in the words of one local minister, not to be fanatical about it.
sentences.zh: 她满足于参与教堂活动，但用当地一位牧师的话说，并不是狂热崇拜。

sentences.en: In contrast, Ralph was eager to learn as much as he could about Christianity.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，拉尔夫渴望尽可能多地了解基督教。

sentences.en: For most of his life he had only attended church for weddings and funerals, but after converting he would constantly engage others on the topic, listening enthusiastically to
sentences.zh: 在他生命的大部分时间里，他只在婚礼和葬礼上才去教堂，但在皈依后，他不断与他人探讨这个话题，热情地倾听那些

sentences.en: those who claimed a deep knowledge of the Bible.
sentences.zh: 自称对《圣经》有着深刻理解的人。

sentences.en: In their home's kitchen he hung a plaque that read,
sentences.zh: 他在家里的厨房挂了一块牌匾，上面写着：

sentences.en: Christ is the head of this house, the unseen guest at every meal, the silent listener to every conversation.
sentences.zh: 基督是这栋房子的主人，是每顿饭时看不见的客人，是每次谈话时无声的倾听者。

sentences.en: Within two years of moving to Antwerp, Joan began exhibiting signs of a mental health crisis.
sentences.zh: 搬到安特卫普不到两年，琼就开始表现出心理健康危机的迹象。

sentences.en: In the spring of 1990, she suddenly became extremely restless, was unable to sleep, and struggled to
sentences.zh: 1990年春天，她突然变得极其焦躁不安，无法入睡，并且很难

sentences.en: concentrate on tasks or conversations, yet seemed oblivious that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 集中精力做事或交谈，然而她似乎对出了问题一无所知。

sentences.en: She also became fixated on her childhood, discussing it frequently in a child-like voice.
sentences.zh: 她还对自己的童年产生了执念，经常用孩子般的声音讨论童年。

sentences.en: One day, she told Ralph that she had done a painting for him, only to reveal she had coated his car in house paint.
sentences.zh: 一天，她告诉拉尔夫她为他画了一幅画，结果却发现她把他汽车的外墙涂料刷上去了。

sentences.en: From the beginning, Ralph suspected that dark forces were responsible for his wife's changes in behaviour.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，拉尔夫就怀疑黑暗力量是导致妻子行为改变的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: He noticed an expression in her eyes that terrified him, describing them as being bright red, almost glowing, almost like coals.
sentences.zh: 他注意到她眼中有一种让他感到恐惧的眼神，形容它们通红，近乎发光，就像煤炭一样。

sentences.en: When she was overcome with a fit of rage outside, a frightened Ralph locked himself in the house.
sentences.zh: 当她在外面被一阵狂怒压倒时，惊恐的拉尔夫把自己反锁在屋里。

sentences.en: He consulted Salvation Army captains at the church the couple attended, seeking guidance on the matter.
sentences.zh: 他咨询了夫妇俩所在教堂的救世军上尉，就此事寻求指导。

sentences.en: Rejecting his suggestion there was, quote, an evil presence in Joan, the captains instead offered the couple marriage counselling.
sentences.zh: 队长们拒绝了琼身上存在所谓“邪灵”的说法，转而建议这对夫妻去接受婚姻咨询。

sentences.en: Displeased with this response, Ralph scheduled a doctor's appointment for Joan at a medical clinic in the nearby town of Dimboola.
sentences.zh: 对这个答复很不满意，拉尔夫为琼在附近丁布拉镇的一家诊所预约了一名医生。

sentences.en: The general practitioner concluded that Joan was suffering from mental illness and should be admitted as an involuntary patient to a psychiatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 全科医生得出结论，称琼患有精神疾病，应当被作为非自愿病人送入精神病院。

sentences.en: In late September, she was taken to Lakeside Mental Health Hospital in the regional city of
sentences.zh: 九月下旬，她被带到了位于该地区城市巴拉瑞特的

sentences.en: Ballarat, a three-hour drive south-east from her home.
sentences.zh: 湖畔精神健康医院，从她家驱车向东南方向行驶需要三个小时。

sentences.en: Psychiatrists there diagnosed Joan with anxiety, depression, schizophrenia and hypomania, a mood
sentences.zh: 那里的精神科医生诊断琼患有焦虑症、抑郁症、精神分裂症和轻度躁狂症——这是一种情绪

sentences.en: disorder which can cause increased energy, difficulty concentrating, restlessness and irritability.
sentences.zh: 障碍，会导致精力增加、难以集中注意力、坐立不安和易怒。

sentences.en: She remained at the hospital for three weeks and by mid-October, her sleep pattern had improved, though it still wasn't back to normal.
sentences.zh: 她在医院呆了三个星期，到十月中旬，她的睡眠模式有所改善，尽管仍未恢复正常。

sentences.en: Upon release, doctors prescribed to Joan an antipsychotic medication called dioridazine, which was then commonly used to treat schizophrenia.
sentences.zh: 出院后，医生给琼开了一种名为硫利达嗪的抗精神病药物，该药当时常用于治疗精神分裂症。

sentences.en: They instructed her to take it for 12 months, cautioning her that if she stopped, there was a strong possibility of relapse within the next two years.
sentences.zh: 他们嘱咐她服用12个月，并警告她如果停药，在未来两年内极有可能会复发。

sentences.en: Nine days after Joan's release, she was still struggling with persistent restlessness, so she and Ralph made another doctor's appointment.
sentences.zh: 在琼出院九天后，她仍然饱受持续的坐立不安之苦，于是她和拉尔夫又预约了一次医生。

sentences.en: Although Joan was coherent, the doctor noted she had difficulty remaining seated and expressed
sentences.zh: 尽管琼思维清晰，但医生注意到她很难安坐，并表示

sentences.en: that the problem might have been the thioridazine, as agitation was a side effect of the drug.
sentences.zh: 问题可能出在硫利达嗪上，因为烦躁不安是该药物的副作用之一。

sentences.en: Joan's dosage was halved and she was also prescribed a second medication to help manage the restlessness.
sentences.zh: 琼的药量减半了，医生还给她开了一种辅助药物来缓解坐立不安的症状。

sentences.en: The doctor asked the couple to return in five days for a follow-up appointment, but she never saw them again.
sentences.zh: 医生要求这对夫妻在五天后来复诊，但她再也没有见到他们。

sentences.en: Joan's continued suffering convinced Ralph that the doctors were unable to help.
sentences.zh: 琼病情持续痛苦，这让拉尔夫坚信医生们已经无能为力。

sentences.en: He suggested to Joan that she submit to deliverance, a form of ministry similar to an exorcism in which an individual is cleansed of evil spirits and demons.
sentences.zh: 他向琼建议，让她接受“释放仪式”——这是一种类似于驱魔的宗教仪式，旨在洗净一个人身上的邪灵和恶魔。

sentences.en: Joan refused, telling her husband, there's nothing wrong with me.
sentences.zh: 琼拒绝了，对丈夫说：“我没毛病。”

sentences.en: Ralph then turned to his religious friends for advice and was instructed to pray to God to bind the spirits.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫随后向他信教的朋友们寻求建议，并被告知要向上帝祈祷以束缚这些恶灵。

sentences.en: He did so, and when Joan's health improved shortly after, Ralph attributed her recovery to his prayers and she ceased taking her medication.
sentences.zh: 他照做了，不久之后当琼的健康状况改善时，拉尔夫将她的康复归功于自己的祈祷，于是她停了药。

sentences.en: Seeing Joan's recovery increased Ralph's faith in God even further and religion became the focal point of his life.
sentences.zh: 看到琼的康复进一步增强了拉尔夫对上帝的信仰，宗教成了他生活的中心。

sentences.en: One neighbour would later recall that while he could have a normal conversation with Joan, it was impossible to talk to Ralph without the subject of religion being raised.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居后来回忆说，虽然他能和琼正常交谈，但跟拉尔夫说话时，对方三句话不离宗教。

sentences.en: In his quest to find like-minded people, Ralph had become acquainted with a couple named John
sentences.zh: 为了寻找志同道合的人，拉尔夫结识了一对名为约翰

sentences.en: and Leanne Reichenbach, both aged 30, who had encouraged him to pray for Joan's recovery.
sentences.zh: 和莉安·赖兴巴赫的夫妇，两人都是30岁，曾鼓励他为琼的康复祈祷。

sentences.en: The Reichenbachs resided on a remote farmstead in the town of Glen Lee, located roughly 28 kilometres west of Antwerp.
sentences.zh: 赖兴巴赫夫妇住在安特卫普以西大约28公里处格伦利镇的一处偏远农庄里。

sentences.en: They had met through their involvement in the Lutheran faith, with Leanne attending services
sentences.zh: 他们因共同的信电路德宗而相识，莉安在波茨姆以南的一个镇上参加礼拜，

sentences.en: in a town south of Portsham, and John's family being well-regarded elders of another nearby church.
sentences.zh: 而约翰的家人则是附近另一间教堂备受尊敬的长老。

sentences.en: They married, and by the early 1990s had four children.
sentences.zh: 两人结婚了，到20世纪90年代初已经有了四个孩子。

sentences.en: Over time, they found themselves increasingly drawn to charismatic Christianity, a fundamentalist
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，他们发现自己越来越被灵恩派基督教所吸引，这是一个原教旨主义

sentences.en: movement that emphasises abilities believed to be bestowed by the Holy Spirit, such as speaking in tongues, performing miracles, and being able to heal the sick.
sentences.zh: 运动，强调他们相信是圣灵赋予的能力，例如说方言、显神迹以及医治病人。

sentences.en: During the early 1990s, the charismatic movement was on the rise throughout the Wimmera region,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代初，灵恩派运动在整个维默拉地区蓬勃发展，

sentences.en: becoming increasingly popular with individuals who had previously practised more conventional branches of Christianity.
sentences.zh: 在那些以前信奉更传统基督教分支的人群中变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: John and Leanne Reichenbach believed they had a divine calling to exercise demons and began performing deliverances.
sentences.zh: 约翰和莉安·赖兴巴赫坚信他们有驱魔的神圣呼召，并开始施行释放仪式。

sentences.en: They also established their own prayer circle at their home, with groups ranging from six to twenty-five people gathering there to sing hymns and study biblical passages.
sentences.zh: 他们还在家中设立了自己的祈祷会，每次有六到二十五人不等的人群聚集在那里唱圣经赞美诗和研读圣经篇章。

sentences.en: Soon, Ralph Vollmer was a regular attendee and developed a close friendship with the couple,
sentences.zh: 很快，拉尔夫·福尔默便成了常客，并与这对夫妇结下了深厚的友谊，

sentences.en: considering them to be the only two truly spirit-filled people of their entire congregation.
sentences.zh: 认为他们是整个会众中仅有的两个真正充满圣灵的人。

sentences.en: However, the Reichenbach's involvement with the charismatic movement led to clashes with their
sentences.zh: 然而，赖兴巴赫夫妇参与灵恩派运动导致了他们与

sentences.en: Lutheran minister.
sentences.zh: 路德宗牧师之间的冲突。

sentences.en: When he pointed out that some of their new beliefs contradicted the Bible's teachings, they would argue that the Lord had spoken to them personally.
sentences.zh: 当牧师指出他们的一些新信仰与圣经教导相矛盾时，他们却辩称主曾亲自对他们说过话。

sentences.en: Their disagreements with the church's doctrine eventually led to them being excommunicated from their congregation in late 1992.
sentences.zh: 他们与教会教义的分歧最终导致他们在1992年底被逐出教会会众。

sentences.en: In early January 1993, Ralph and Joan travelled to Adelaide to attend a six-day charismatic movement convention that the Reichenbachs had recommended to them.
sentences.zh: 在1993年1月上旬，拉尔夫和琼前往阿德莱德参加一个为期六天的灵恩派运动大会，这是赖兴巴赫夫妇向他们推荐的。

sentences.en: The week-long event was characterised by lots of singing, preaching, and people performing minor miracles such as healing and casting out demons.
sentences.zh: 这个为期一周的活动充满了唱歌、讲道，以及人们表演医治和驱魔等小型神迹。

sentences.en: Throughout it all, Joan seemed moody and withdrawn, but the trip passed without any significant incidents.
sentences.zh: 在这一切过程中，琼显得情绪化且孤僻，但这次旅行没有发生任何重大事故。

sentences.en: When the couple arrived back home on Sunday January 10, Joan's manic symptoms returned and quickly worsened.
sentences.zh: 当这对夫妻在1月10日星期日回到家时，琼的狂躁症状复发并迅速恶化。

sentences.en: She was once again restless and unable to sleep, and, according to Ralph, would snort like a pig,
sentences.zh: 她再次变得坐立不安、无法入睡，据拉尔夫所说，她会像猪一样呼噜呼噜地叫，

sentences.en: make aggressive facial expressions that he compared to an angry dog, swear loudly, and speak about lewd activities.
sentences.zh: 做出他比作愤怒野狗的攻击性面部表情，大声说脏话，并谈论下流的勾当。

sentences.en: Ralph attributed Joan's behaviour to spiritual probleMs.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫将琼的行为归咎于精神问题。

sentences.en: When he had prayed to bind the evil spirit within her two years earlier, he believed he had rendered it ineffective but failed to cast it out.
sentences.zh: 当他在两年前祈祷以束缚她体内的邪灵时，他认为自己已经使其失去了效用，但未能将其驱逐出去。

sentences.en: Now, he suspected it had been reawakened by the strong spiritual atmosphere and nourishment of the convention and was rebelling against it.
sentences.zh: 现在，他怀疑邪灵是被大会强烈的属灵氛围和滋养重新唤醒了，并正在对此进行反抗。

sentences.en: Over the next ten days, Ralph prayed often for guidance, but worried that he was harassing God with concerns that he was already aware of.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的十天里，拉尔夫经常祈求指引，但又担心自己是在用上帝早已知晓的忧虑去打扰他。

sentences.en: As a reminder to himself, Ralph painted the words,
sentences.zh: 为了提醒自己，拉尔夫用红漆在

sentences.en: Stop Telling Father Your Needs in red paint on an outside wall of the property's pigsty.
sentences.zh: 房产猪圈的外墙上刷上了“不要再把你的需求告诉天父”这几个字。

sentences.en: On Thursday January 21, 63-year-old Roma Carras caught the bus from Horsham to Antwerp to stay with her friend to Joan Vollmer.
sentences.zh: 1月21日星期四，63岁的罗马·卡拉斯乘长途汽车从霍舍姆赶到安特卫普，去看望她的朋友琼·福尔默。

sentences.en: It was the middle of summer, and temperatures in the region were consistently soaring above
sentences.zh: 当时正值盛夏，该地区的温度持续飙升至

sentences.en: 40 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 40摄氏度以上。

sentences.en: When Roma greeted Joan, she was shocked to find her friend dressed in a nighty and heavy dressing gown, but with ice-cold hands.
sentences.zh: 当罗马向琼问候时，她震惊地发现朋友穿着睡衣和厚重的晨衣，双手却冰凉。

sentences.en: Throughout the visit, Joan restacked crockery, pulled apart flowers from a bouquet Roma had given
sentences.zh: 在探访期间，琼重新摆放陶器，把罗马送给她的花束扯碎，

sentences.en: her and sang in a peculiar voice that Roma described as lovely, like a nightingale.
sentences.zh: 并用一种罗马形容为美妙、像夜莺般奇特的嗓音唱歌。

sentences.en: Roma also observed that Joan's stomach appeared to be swollen.
sentences.zh: 罗马还观察到琼的肚子似乎肿胀了。

sentences.en: Joan told Roma that she was both expecting a baby and that the swelling was due to a cancerous tumour.
sentences.zh: 琼告诉罗马，她既怀了孕，而且腹部肿胀也是因为患有癌症肿瘤。

sentences.en: She insisted that there were people on the property who wanted to rape her, but when she tried to point them out to her friend, Roma saw nothing.
sentences.zh: 她坚称庄园里有人想要强奸她，但当她试图向朋友指出这些人时，罗马什么也没看到。

sentences.en: Believing that Joan was heading for, quote, a nervous breakdown, Roma told Ralph of her concerns on the following morning of Friday January 22, before returning home.
sentences.zh: 罗马认为琼正走向所谓的“精神崩溃”，于是在1月22日星期五的第二天早上返回家乡前，向拉尔夫表达了她的担忧。

sentences.en: That evening, Ralph returned home from shopping to find Joan dancing barefoot in the paddocks while waving her arms and calling out to him.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，拉尔夫购物回家，发现琼正光着脚在牧场里跳舞，挥舞着双臂并向他大声呼喊。

sentences.en: He escorted her into the house, only for Joan to run away and be found later that night four kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 他把她护送进屋，结果琼却跑了出去，当晚晚些时候在四公里外被找到。

sentences.en: Deeply disturbed, Ralph prayed to God for guidance as to where he should turn for help.
sentences.zh: 深受困扰的拉尔夫向上帝祈求指引，以决定该去哪里寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Believing he received an answer to reach out to the Reichenbachs, he phoned John and asked him to come over.
sentences.zh: 他相信自己得到了联系赖兴巴赫夫妇的启示，于是打电话给约翰并请他过来。

sentences.en: John arrived at the Vollmer residence at around 11.30pm.
sentences.zh: 约翰于晚上11点30分左右抵达福尔默的住所。

sentences.en: He and Leanne had participated in as many as 20 deliverances by this time, and upon seeing
sentences.zh: 此时他和莉安已经参与过多达20次释放仪式，一看到

sentences.en: the state that Joan was in, John quickly deduced that she was a victim of demonic possession.
sentences.zh: 琼当时的状况，约翰很快断定她是恶魔附身的受害者。

sentences.en: He told Ralph that deliverance was no longer an option, but a necessary action in order to save her soul.
sentences.zh: 他告诉拉尔夫，释放仪式已不再是一个选择，而是为了拯救她的灵魂所必须采取的行动。

sentences.en: Ralph agreed, and the two of them stayed awake all night praying for Joan and reading passages aloud from the Bible.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫表示同意，两人整夜未眠，为琼祈祷并大声朗读圣经篇章。

sentences.en: The next morning of Saturday January 23, Leanne Reichenbach arrived and took her husband's place by Joan's side, while John returned home to the couple's children.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，即1月23日星期六，莉安·赖兴巴赫赶到并取代她丈夫守在琼身旁，而约翰则回家照看夫妇俩的孩子。

sentences.en: She phoned other members of their circle to ask for their guidance and assistance in praying for Joan.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给他们祈祷圈的其他成员，请求他们指导并协助为琼祈祷。

sentences.en: At the top of her list was Leah Clugston, a 77-year-old Baptist who resided in the town of Rainbow, 52 kilometres north of Antwerp.
sentences.zh: 排在她名单首位的是莉亚·克卢格斯顿，她是一位77岁的浸信会信徒，住在安特卫普以北52公里处的雷恩博镇。

sentences.en: The Reichenbachs considered Leah to be something of a spiritual leader, as she claimed to speak directly with God.
sentences.zh: 赖兴巴赫夫妇将莉亚视为什么精神领袖般的存在，因为她声称自己能直接与上帝对话。

sentences.en: After consulting with Leanne over the telephone, Leah came to the conclusion that Joan was possessed
sentences.zh: 在与利亚恩电话沟通后，利亚得出结论：琼附身的不是一个，而是足足十个恶魔实体，并就如何驱逐这些邪灵提出了建议。

sentences.en: by not one but ten demonic entities and provided advice on how to expel the evil spirits.
sentences.zh: 按照利亚的指示，拉尔夫和利亚恩让琼坐在厨房一端的椅子上，

sentences.en: Following Leah's instructions, Ralph and Leanne had Joan sit in a chair at one end of the kitchen
sentences.zh: 而他们坐在另一端，背诵圣经段落、祈祷、向琼提问，背景则播放着基督教音乐。

sentences.en: while they sat at the other, reciting biblical passages, praying, and asking Joan questions while Christian music played in the background.
sentences.zh: 这种模式在接下来的两天里不断重复。

sentences.en: This pattern repeated over the next two days.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫和利亚恩的驱魔仪式通常在下午中段开始，一直持续到深夜，有时甚至要到凌晨5点才结束。

sentences.en: Ralph and Leanne's deliverance sessions commenced during the mid-afternoon and continued throughout the night, sometimes not concluding until 5am.
sentences.zh: 有时，约翰·赖兴巴赫会亲自加入他们，但其他时候，他们会定期打电话向他以及利亚和祈祷圈的其他几位成员寻求建议。

sentences.en: Occasionally, John Reichenbach would join them in person, but other times they regularly called him for advice, along with Leah and several other prayer circle members.
sentences.zh: 在琼的行为持续三天没有改变后，大家决定需要找其他人加入他们，以加强驱魔力度。

sentences.en: After three days with no change in Joan's behaviour, it was decided that they needed someone else to join them and strengthen their efforts.

sentences.zh: 本案档案稍后继续。

sentences.en: David Klingner was a 28-year-old contract harvester who had grown up in northern New South
sentences.zh: 大卫·克林格是一名 28 岁的合同收割工，他在新南威尔士州北部长大，

sentences.en: Wales but now lived in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 但现在住在南澳大利亚州。

sentences.en: He had attended the Reichenbach's prayer circles on a number of occasions where he had become acquainted with Ralph Vollmer as well.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次参加赖肯巴赫的祷告会，并在那里结识了拉尔夫·福尔默。

sentences.en: David had also met Joan and already harboured some suspicions about her, even before receiving
sentences.zh: 大卫也见过琼，甚至在接到莉安·赖肯巴赫打来的电话、解释琼正在接受驱魔之前，他就已经对琼产生了一些怀疑。

sentences.en: phone calls from Leanne Reichenbach explaining that Joan was undergoing a deliverance.
sentences.zh: 四周前的新年前夜祷告会上，他曾见过福尔默夫妇，并认为琼在礼拜期间面无表情。

sentences.en: He had seen the Vollmers at a New Year's Eve prayer gathering four weeks earlier and thought that Joan had a blank expression on her face during the service.
sentences.zh: 四周前的新年前夜祷告会上，他曾见过福尔默夫妇，并认为琼在礼拜期间面无表情。

sentences.en: At one stage, he believed he saw her eyes roll back into her head.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他确信自己看到她的双眼往眼眶后翻去。

sentences.en: From that moment, he suspected there was a demonic presence in her and now that had seemingly been confirmed.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，他就怀疑她体内有恶魔存在，而现在这一点似乎得到了证实。

sentences.en: When the group asked him to join them, he felt it was his duty to assiSt.
sentences.zh: 当这个团体邀请他加入时，他觉得协助他们是自己的责任。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, January 26, David made the considerable journey across the state border to Antwerp.
sentences.zh: 1月26日星期二，大卫长途跋涉跨越州界来到了安特卫普。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at the property, he felt that the atmosphere there was like that of a, quote, spiritual battle between God and Satan.
sentences.zh: 一到达那处房产，他就觉得那里的气氛就像是上帝与撒旦之间的一场灵性之战。

sentences.en: He prayed and read from the Bible along with Ralph and Leanne.
sentences.zh: 他和拉尔夫以及莉安一起祈祷并诵读圣经。

sentences.en: The trio maintained their efforts throughout the entire day and into Wednesday as well, regularly checking in with their prayer circle associates.
sentences.zh: 三人的努力持续了一整天，一直延续到周三，期间他们还与祈祷圈的同伴们保持定期联系。

sentences.en: According to David, Joan became increasingly verbally abusive and aggressive as time went on.
sentences.zh: 据大卫称，随着时间的推移，琼变得越来越爱口出恶言且富有攻击性。

sentences.en: By Thursday, January 28, Joan's restlessness had worsened to the point that she refused to stay seated and resisted the group's prayers.
sentences.zh: 到了1月28日星期四，琼的焦躁不安已经恶化到她拒绝坐着，并抗拒众人的祈祷。

sentences.en: In response, Ralph suggested they'd tie her feet to wooden planks to prevent her from moving around and making what he described as satanic gestures.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，拉尔夫建议将她的双脚绑在木板上，以防止她四处走动并做出他所描述的撒旦手势。

sentences.en: They also began depriving Joan of food and water as a way of starving the demons inside her.
sentences.zh: 他们还开始剥夺琼的食物和水，以此来饿死她体内的恶魔。

sentences.en: When she complained of her hunger and thirst, they would pray even louder to drown out her cries.
sentences.zh: 当她抱怨饥饿和口渴时，他们就会更大声地祈祷，以盖过她的哭喊声。

sentences.en: Their questioning of Joan persisted, and if she didn't provide satisfactory replies, they slapped her face as a means of telling her, in Ralph's words, come on, give us an answer.
sentences.zh: 他们对琼的盘问一直在继续，如果她没有给出令人满意的回答，他们就会掌掴她的脸，用拉尔夫的话说，这就是为了告诉她：快点，给我们一个回答。

sentences.en: On a couple of occasions, Ralph became distressed at witnessing the torment his wife was enduring, including the bruises that had formed on her skin.
sentences.zh: 有好几次，拉尔夫看到妻子正在承受的折磨，包括她皮肤上形成的淤青，感到十分痛苦。

sentences.en: When he voiced his concerns that this could not be God's will,
sentences.zh: 当他表达担忧，认为这不可能是上帝的旨意时，

sentences.en: Leanne and David pointed out to Ralph that it wasn't his wife they were physically battling, but a demonic presence.
sentences.zh: 莉安和大卫向拉尔夫指出，他们肉体上与之搏斗的不是他的妻子，而是恶魔的存在。

sentences.en: They reassured him that they were, quote, not harming Joan in any way, we were just dealing with the evil spirit.
sentences.zh: 他们向他保证，用他们的话说，“我们绝没有以任何方式伤害琼，我们只是在对付邪灵”。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the group were at a loss as to why they couldn't see any improvement in Joan's well-being, despite the growing intensity of their deliverance.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管驱魔仪式的强度不断增加，但对于为什么琼的健康状况没有丝毫改善，这群人感到不知所措。

sentences.en: Leah advised them over the phone that they would need to call for more reinforcements if the demons still remained by Saturday.
sentences.zh: 莉亚通过电话建议他们，如果到周六恶魔仍然没有离开，他们就需要叫来更多援兵。

sentences.en: Throughout the exorcism, the group had also been consulting fellow prayer circle attendee
sentences.zh: 在整个驱魔过程中，该团体还一直通过电话咨询祈祷圈的另一位成员

sentences.en: Kathleen Nusky over the phone.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·纳斯基。

sentences.en: Like Leah Clugston, Kathleen lived in Rainbow and felt it was her obligation to assist with prayers and guidance.
sentences.zh: 和莉娅·克拉格斯顿一样，凯瑟琳住在雷恩博，她觉得协助祈祷和提供指导是自己的责任。

sentences.en: In the face of the group's continued failure to exercise Joan's demons,
sentences.zh: 面对该团体接连未能驱除琼体内的恶魔这一情况，

sentences.en: Kathleen suggested that her son, 22-year-old Matthew Paul Nusky, join them.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳建议她的儿子、22岁的马修·保罗·纳斯基加入他们。

sentences.en: Matthew lived nearly 400 kilometres away in the Melbourne suburb of Warrandyte and was employed as an assistant greenkeeper at a golf course.
sentences.zh: 马修住在近400公里外的墨尔本华兰迪特郊区，在一家高尔夫球场担任助理绿化工。

sentences.en: He had never participated in a deliverance before, but Kathleen advised that he was particularly sensitive to the message of God and the presence of evil,
sentences.zh: 他以前从未参加过驱魔仪式，但凯瑟琳说他对神的旨意和邪恶的存在格外敏感，

sentences.en: having previously detected demons that resided in a house that he lived in.
sentences.zh: 因为他以前曾察觉到自己住过的房子里有恶魔盘踞。

sentences.en: When Saturday January 30 dawned with no perceivable change in Joan,
sentences.zh: 当1月30日星期六黎明到来，琼依然没有任何明显的变化时，

sentences.en: Kathleen called her son and he agreed to make the long drive to Antwerp.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳给儿子打了电话，马修同意长途驱车前往安特卫普。

sentences.en: It was another hot day, with the temperature reaching 40 degrees by noon when Matthew Paul Nusky pulled up to the property.
